description: Header file defining the ProofSourceX509 class, which manages X.509 certificates with private keys for QUIC protocol cryptographic operations.

classes.name: ProofSourceX509
classes.description: Manages X.509 certificates with private keys, providing cryptographic proof and certificate selection based on SubjectAltName.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ProofSourceX509 instance with a default certificate chain and key.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic proof for a given server and client address, hostname, and server configuration.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain matching the hostname, or the default if none matches.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the specified signature algorithm.

methods.name: SupportedTlsSignatureAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns the list of supported TLS signature algorithms.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the TicketCrypter used for encrypting/decrypting session tickets.

methods.name: AddCertificateChain
methods.description: Adds a certificate chain and private key to the verifier, overriding existing certificates with the same SubjectAltName.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the default certificate is valid.

methods.name: MaybeAddSctsForHostname
methods.description: Virtual method for subclasses to add SCTs for a hostname.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Looks up a certificate for a hostname, returning the default if none matches.
